myanmar-arakan-conflict.name: Rakhine
myanmar-arakan-conflict.note: The Arakan administration governed fourteen of the seventeen townships. The State Security and Peace Commission retained authority in Sittwe, Kyaukphyu, and Munaung. The game combines those jurisdictions into one province.

myanmar-karen-conflict.name: Kayin
myanmar-karen-conflict.note: The Karen National Union had majority territorial control in the 2025 survey and operates a regional administration. The stock province also includes areas administered by the central military government and other Karen authorities.

ucdp-state-14784.name: Hasakah
ucdp-state-14784.note: The Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria governed most of Hasakah. The stock province also includes the northern strip outside the Kurdish-led administration.

ucdp-state-14784.name: Raqqa
ucdp-state-14784.note: The Kurdish-led administration governed much of Raqqa including its provincial capital. Parts of the north and west fell outside its administration.

syr-suwayda-government.name: Suwayda
syr-suwayda-government.note: Local Druze authorities held Suwayda city and most of the governorate. Several communities and jurisdictions remain inside the same stock province.
